body: REDGARDEN commit b49b9a6. In-fiction reason all nine NORTHSTAR §7 heroes are a roster: recruited one at a time into a loose gang, tying into why several (Tree, Pizza, Retrieval Cart, Doc Wheel) touch the living grid itself. Cross-referenced from docs/HEROES_VS0.md and NORTHSTAR.md §9.
